title: A Blacksmith's Revenge
shortDescription: First-person VR tower defense where you fortify your home and face waves of adventurers.
longDescription: A Blacksmith's Revenge is a first-person VR tower defense experience. You place traps, fortify your home, and fight off waves of adventurers who underestimate the blacksmith they're raiding.

title: Agrunare
shortDescription: A mix of FPS and deck-building where you hack through surreal digital landscapes.
longDescription: Agrunare blends first-person shooting with deck-building. You play as a hacker entering digital landscapes, equipping different programs (abilities) to defeat hostile viruses in a shifting virtual world.

title: Project Myth
shortDescription: Explore an abandoned library at night as a contemporary artist.
longDescription: Project Myth is a mood‑driven experience where you play a contemporary artist visiting an abandoned library at night. The focus is on atmosphere, environmental storytelling, and subtle unease instead of jumpscares.

title: MythBreaker
shortDescription: Third-person hack ’n’ slash RPG about breaking myths through combat.
longDescription: MythBreaker is a third‑person hack ’n’ slash RPG where you fight waves of enemies using fast, expressive combat. The project explores character‑driven action and stylized, myth‑inspired visuals.

title: Project 5
longDescription: An additional project slot reserved for future work. This space will host another piece combining art, design, and interactive storytelling.

title: Project 6
longDescription: Another placeholder project for upcoming experiments in visual design, prototypes, or collaborations.
